rows.grounds: compound of saṃkhyā (number) and hīna (devoid); object of kartavyam
more than the prescribed number; subject of duṣyati

items.question: What ritual consequence follows from making the prescribed count deficient or excessive?
premises: The prescribed count must not be made deficient.
An excessive count is also considered in relation to the rule.
An excessive count does not become faulty.
items.inference: Deficiency in the prescribed count is prohibited, whereas excess does not incur fault.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the count depends on the preceding verses' ritual context.
items.plain_english: The count should not be made less than prescribed, but making it more is not at all faulty.
